import random

r = random.Random(20260926)
n = 100
m = 100
lines = [f'{n} {m}']
for _ in range(n):
    k = r.randint(2, 5)
    ts = r.sample(range(1, m + 1), k)
    lines.append(' '.join(map(str, [k] + ts)))
print('\n'.join(lines))
